text:
nora: Heads-up: leadership wants a narrower MVP to avoid a timeline slip. My suggestion: MVP = hosted API + compact embedding-cache (no per-tenant routing) + email 2FA. Move org SSO and tenant routing to v1. Need quick reactions.

diego: +1 to removing tenant routing from MVP. Biggest unknowns are networking and RBAC edge cases.

faye: Design: we can do an account switcher and clear opt-in language for tenant alpha. Keep UX overhead small.

sam: Data/infra: embedding-cache is high impact on cost. We can ship a hosted-only cache with simplified config. That saves ~10 dev days vs full routing. However quantization QA must land before ga.

nora: Proposed rollout guardrail: canary window 30m, p95 latency threshold 380ms, 5xx >1% triggers fallback to quantized model and disable cache writes. Can we agree?

diego: Agree. Add an embedding_hit_rate watch and alert if it drops >12% after quantized fallback.

faye: I'll prepare the compact UX copy and a short FAQ for sales.

sam: I'll draft the canary checklist and implementation ticket with kill-switch flag.

pm-bot: Milestone updated: https://redwood/issue/MILE-900. Fields: mvp_scope="hosted-api,hosted-embcache,email-2fa"; v1_scope="tenant-routing,org-sso,sms-totp".

nora: If no objections by EOD I'll lock scope and notify stakeholders. Speak now if concerns.
diego: No objections.
faye: No objections.
sam: No objections.
nora: Locking scope. Thanks team. :lock:
